Here, we build and store the models required to obtain vital rate parameters to feed to the IPM.

## Setup

As usual, we fist load the package and get the data.

```{r}
library(whereipm)
library(tidyverse)
library(glmmTMB)

# loading the data
data <- ipmdata


# I am here also defining 3 colours I will later use for plotting
col.early <- wesanderson::wes_palette("Darjeeling1", 3)[1]
col.mid <- wesanderson::wes_palette("Darjeeling1", 3)[2]
col.late <- wesanderson::wes_palette("Darjeeling1", 3)[3]
```

To study how the evolution of dispersal and life-history affects the spatial ecology of the population we are splitting the 5 years of observation in 3 phases:

1. Early phase, between a month after introduction and month 18;
2. Mid phase, between month 27 and 36;
3. Late pahse, between month 47 and 62.

The length of the phases is biased to allow more similar sample sizes, which should allow similar power to find significant results.

I will also subset the dataset to include only pools, and only females.

```{r}
# subsetting for sex, habitat and time. 
# Here I am considering only females since for males the number of offspring sired
# is complicated by sperm storage in females.
data.early <- data %>%
  filter(sex == "F" & Habitat=='P' & time>=7 & time<=18)
data.mid <- data %>% 
  filter(sex == "F" & Habitat=='P' & time>=29 & time<=40)
data.late <- data %>%
  filter(sex == "F" & Habitat=='P' & time>=51 & time<=62)
```

## Models

I will run 6 model trios, for different life-history and dispersal traits:

1. Survival;
2. Recruitment;
3. Adult dispersal probability;
4. Adult dispersal distance;
5. Natal dispersal probability;
6. Natal dispersal distance.

### Survival

```{r, results = "asis", fig.height=4, fig.width=4}
# For survival, Local density is the only covariate.
# Random effects include individual identity, reach and sampling.

e.survival <- lme4::glmer(survival ~ s_loc_density +
                            + (1|FishID)  + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                          data=data.early,
                          family=binomial,
                          lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))

m.survival <- lme4::glmer(survival ~ s_loc_density +
                            + (1|FishID)  + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                          data=data.mid,
                          family=binomial,
                          lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))

l.survival <- lme4::glmer(survival ~ s_loc_density +
                            + (1|FishID) + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                          data=data.late,
                          family=binomial,
                          lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))

stargazer::stargazer(e.survival, m.survival, l.survival,
                     type = "html",
                     title = "Models for survival",
                     report = "vcsp*",
                     covariate.labels = "Local density",
                     column.labels = c("Early phase", "Mid phase", "Late phase"),
                     dep.var.caption = "Survival probability",
                     dep.var.labels = "")

# plotting survival across densities in the three phases
dens <- seq(0, 50, length.out = 100)
# using custom made function predictGLMM to calculate survival in each phase, across density values
s.e = predictGLMM(x = dens, 
                  Coefs = summary(e.survival)$coefficients, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "logit")
s.m = predictGLMM(x = dens, 
                  Coefs = summary(m.survival)$coefficients, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "logit")
s.l = predictGLMM(x = dens, 
                  Coefs = summary(l.survival)$coefficients, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "logit")
            

plot(s.e ~ dens, ylim = c(0,1), type = 'l', col = col.early, lwd = 2, xaxt = 'n', yaxt = 'n', xlab = 'density (individuals/m)', ylab = '')
lines(s.m ~ dens, col = col.mid, lwd = 2)
lines(s.l ~ dens, col = col.late, lwd = 2)
axis(1, at=c(0,10,20,30,40, 50), labels = c(0,10,20,30,40, 50))
axis(2, at=c(0,.25,.5,.75,1), las = 2)
mtext('p', side = 2, las=2, line=3)
abline(h = 1, lty = 3)
legend('bottomright', lty = 1, legend = c("early", "mid", "late"), 
       col = c(col.early, col.mid, col.late))
```

### Recruitment

```{r, results = "asis", fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
# For recruitment, the random effect structure is simplified, excluding a random slope for sampling.

e.recruit <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(recruited ~ s_loc_density +
                                + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (1|sampling),
                              ziformula = ~ s_loc_density +
                                + (1|FishID) +  (1|reach) + (1|sampling),
                              family="truncated_poisson"(link="log"),
                              data = data.early,
                              na.action = na.omit)

m.recruit <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(recruited ~ s_loc_density +
                                + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (1|sampling),
                              ziformula = ~ s_loc_density +
                                + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (1|sampling),
                              family="truncated_poisson"(link="log"),
                              data=data.mid,
                              na.action = na.omit)

l.recruit <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(recruited ~ s_loc_density +
                                + (1|FishID)+ (1|reach) + (1|sampling),
                              ziformula = ~ s_loc_density +
                                + (1|FishID)+ (1|reach) +  (1|sampling),
                              family="truncated_poisson"(link="log"),
                              data=data.late,
                              na.action = na.omit)

sjPlot::tab_model(e.recruit, m.recruit, l.recruit,
                  show.icc = F, show.aic = F, show.se = T, show.est = T,
                  pred.labels = c("(Intercept)", "Local density"),
                  dv.labels = c("Early phase", "Mid phase", "Late phase"),
                  show.ci = F)


# plotting reproduction probability and number of offspring for the three phases, at various density values
# Reproduction probability 
# (remember this is probability to NOT reproduce, since it's a zero inflation model)
r.e = 1- predictGLMM(x = dens, 
                  Coefs = summary(e.recruit)$coefficients$zi, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "logit")
r.m = 1- predictGLMM(x = dens, 
                  Coefs = summary(m.recruit)$coefficients$zi, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "logit")
r.l = 1- predictGLMM(x = dens, 
                  Coefs = summary(l.recruit)$coefficients$zi, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "logit")
# Offspring number
o.e = predictGLMM(x = dens, 
                  Coefs = summary(e.recruit)$coefficients$cond, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "truncated-pois")
o.m = predictGLMM(x = dens, 
                  Coefs = summary(m.recruit)$coefficients$cond, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "truncated-pois")
o.l = predictGLMM(x = dens, 
                  Coefs = summary(l.recruit)$coefficients$cond, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "truncated-pois")

par(mfrow = c(1,2))
# Reproduction
plot(r.e ~ dens, ylim = c(0,1), type = 'l', col = col.early, lwd = 2, xaxt = 'n', yaxt = 'n', xlab = 'density (individuals/m)', ylab = '', main = "Reproduction")
lines(r.m ~ dens, col = col.mid, lwd = 2)
lines(r.l ~ dens, col = col.late, lwd = 2)
axis(1, at=c(0,10,20,30,40, 50), labels = c(0,10,20,30,40, 50))
axis(2, at=c(0,.25,.5,.75,1), las = 2)
mtext('p', side = 2, las=2, line=3)
abline(h = 0, lty = 3)
# Offspring number
plot(o.e ~ dens, ylim = c(1,2.5), type = 'l', col = col.early, lwd = 2, xaxt = 'n', yaxt = 'n', xlab = 'density (individuals/m)', ylab = '', main = "Offspring number")
lines(o.m ~ dens, col = col.mid, lwd = 2)
lines(o.l ~ dens, col = col.late, lwd = 2)
axis(1, at=c(0,10,20,30,40, 50), labels = c(0,10,20,30,40, 50))
axis(2, at=c(0,1, 2, 3), las = 2)
mtext('n', side = 2, las=2, line=2)
abline(h = 1, lty = 3)

legend('topright', lty = 1, legend = c("early", "mid", "late"), 
       col = c(col.early, col.mid, col.late))
```

### Adult dispersal

```{r, results = "asis"}
e.dispersal.p <- lme4::glmer(p_moving ~ s_loc_density +
                               + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                             family = 'binomial',
                             data = data.early,
                             lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))

m.dispersal.p <- lme4::glmer(p_moving ~ s_loc_density +
                               + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                             family = 'binomial',
                             data = data.mid,
                             lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))

l.dispersal.p <- lme4::glmer(p_moving ~ s_loc_density +
                               + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                             family = 'binomial',
                             data = data.late,
                             lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))

stargazer::stargazer(e.dispersal.p, m.dispersal.p, l.dispersal.p,
                     type = "html",
                     title = "Adult dispersal probability",
                     report = "vcsp*",
                     covariate.labels = "Local density",
                     column.labels = c("Early phase", "Mid phase", "Late phase"),
                     dep.var.caption = "Dispersal probability",
                     dep.var.labels = "")

```

### Adult dispersal distance

```{r, results = "asis", fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
e.dispersal.dist <- lme4::lmer(log(dist_moved) ~ 1 +
                                 + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (1|sampling),
                               data = data.early)

m.dispersal.dist <- lme4::lmer(log(dist_moved) ~ 1 +
                                 + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (1|sampling),
                               data = data.mid)

l.dispersal.dist <- lme4::lmer(log(dist_moved) ~ 1 +
                                 + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (1|sampling),
                               data = data.late)

stargazer::stargazer(e.dispersal.dist, m.dispersal.dist, l.dispersal.dist,
                     type = "html",
                     title = "Models for adult dispersal distance",
                     report = "vcsp*",
                     column.labels = c("Early phase", "Mid phase", "Late phase"),
                     dep.var.caption = "Dispersal distance",
                     dep.var.labels = "")


# plotting dispersal probability and distance
# Probability
dp.e <- predictGLMM(x = dens, 
                  Coefs = summary(e.dispersal.p)$coefficients, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "logit")
dp.m <- predictGLMM(x = dens, 
                  Coefs = summary(m.dispersal.p)$coefficients, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "logit")
dp.l <- predictGLMM(x = dens, 
                  Coefs = summary(l.dispersal.p)$coefficients, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "logit")
# Distance
dd.e <- predictGLMM(x = dens, 
                  Coefs = summary(e.dispersal.dist)$coefficients, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "log")
dd.m <- predictGLMM(x = dens, 
                  Coefs = summary(m.dispersal.dist)$coefficients, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "log")
dd.l <- predictGLMM(x = dens, 
                  Coefs = summary(l.dispersal.dist)$coefficients, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "log")

# plots
par(mfrow = c(1,2))
plot(dp.e ~ dens, ylim = c(0,1), type = 'l', col = col.early, lwd = 2, xaxt = 'n', yaxt = 'n', xlab = 'density (individuals/m)', ylab = '', main = "Dispersal Probability")
lines(dp.m ~ dens, col = col.mid, lwd = 2)
lines(dp.l ~ dens, col = col.late, lwd = 2)
axis(1, at=c(0,10,20,30,40, 50), labels = c(0,10,20,30,40, 50))
axis(2, at=c(0,.25,.5,.75,1), las = 2)
mtext('p', side = 2, las=2, line=3)
abline(h = 0, lty = 3)
abline(h = 1, lty = 3)

plot(dd.e ~ dens, ylim = c(0,10), type = 'l', col = col.early, lwd = 2, xaxt = 'n', xlab = 'density (individuals/m)', ylab = '', main = "Dispersal Distance", las = 1)
lines(dd.m ~ dens, col = col.mid, lwd = 2)
lines(dd.l ~ dens, col = col.late, lwd = 2)
axis(1, at=c(0,10,20,30,40, 50), labels = c(0,10,20,30,40, 50))
mtext('distance(m)', side = 2, line=2)

legend('bottomright', lty = 1, legend = c("early", "mid", "late"), 
       col = c(col.early, col.mid, col.late))
```

### Natal dispersal probability

```{r, results = "asis"}
# Since the DDD paper show importance of landscape density on natal dispersal, here I include it in the analyses
e.natal.p <- lme4::glmer(p_natal ~ s_loc_density.mid*s_land_density.mid +
                           + (1|Maternity) + (1|reach.birth) + (s_loc_density.mid|sampling.birth),
                         family = 'binomial',
                         data = data.early,
                         lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))

m.natal.p <- lme4::glmer(p_natal ~ s_loc_density.mid*s_land_density.mid +
                           + (1|Maternity) + (1|reach.birth) + (s_loc_density.mid|sampling.birth),
                         family = 'binomial',
                         data = data.mid,
                         lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))

l.natal.p <- lme4::glmer(p_natal ~ s_loc_density.mid*s_land_density.mid +
                           + (1|Maternity) + (1|reach.birth) + (s_loc_density|sampling.birth),
                         family = 'binomial',
                         data = data.late,
                         lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))

stargazer::stargazer(e.natal.p, m.natal.p, l.natal.p,
                     type = "html",
                     title = "Natal dispersal probability",
                     report = "vcsp*",
                     covariate.labels = c("Local density", "Landscape density",
                                          "Local x Landscape desity"),
                     column.labels = c("Early phase", "Mid phase", "Late phase"),
                     dep.var.caption = "Dispersal probability",
                     dep.var.labels = "")
```

### Natal dispersal distance

```{r, results = "asis", fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
e.natal.dist <- lme4::lmer(log(dist_natal) ~ 1 + 
                             + (1|Maternity) + (1|reach.birth) + (1|sampling.birth),
                           data = data.early)

m.natal.dist <- lme4::lmer(log(dist_natal) ~ 1 + 
                             + (1|Maternity) + (1|reach.birth) + (1|sampling.birth),
                           data = data.mid)

l.natal.dist <- lme4::lmer(log(dist_natal) ~ 1  + 
                             + (1|Maternity) + (1|reach.birth) + (1|sampling.birth),
                           data = data.late)

stargazer::stargazer(e.natal.dist, m.natal.dist, l.natal.dist,
                     type = "html",
                     title = "Natal dispersal distance",
                     report = "vcsp*",
                     covariate.labels = c("Landscape density"),
                     column.labels = c("Early phase", "Mid phase", "Late phase"),
                     dep.var.caption = "Dispersal distance",
                     dep.var.labels = "")


# plotting dispersal probability and distance
# Probability
np.e <- predictGLMM(x = dens, 
                  Coefs = summary(e.natal.p)$coefficients, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "logit")
np.m <- predictGLMM(x = dens, 
                  Coefs = summary(m.natal.p)$coefficients, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "logit")
np.l <- predictGLMM(x = dens, 
                  Coefs = summary(l.natal.p)$coefficients, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "logit")
# Distance
nd.e <- predictGLMM(x = dens, 
                  Coefs = summary(e.natal.dist)$coefficients, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "log")
nd.m <- predictGLMM(x = dens, 
                  Coefs = summary(m.natal.dist)$coefficients, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "log")
nd.l <- predictGLMM(x = dens, 
                  Coefs = summary(l.natal.dist)$coefficients, 
                  scalingValue = scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                  link = "log")

# plots
par(mfrow = c(1,2))
plot(np.e ~ dens, ylim = c(0,1), type = 'l', col = col.early, lwd = 2, xaxt = 'n', yaxt = 'n', xlab = 'density (individuals/m)', ylab = '', main = "Dispersal Probability")
lines(np.m ~ dens, col = col.mid, lwd = 2)
lines(np.l ~ dens, col = col.late, lwd = 2)
axis(1, at=c(0,10,20,30,40, 50), labels = c(0,10,20,30,40, 50))
axis(2, at=c(0,.25,.5,.75,1), las = 2)
mtext('p', side = 2, las=2, line=3)
abline(h = 0, lty = 3)
abline(h = 1, lty = 3)

plot(nd.e ~ dens, ylim = c(0,20), type = 'l', col = col.early, lwd = 2, xaxt = 'n', xlab = 'density (individuals/m)', ylab = '', main = "Dispersal Distance", las = 1)
lines(nd.m ~ dens, col = col.mid, lwd = 2)
lines(nd.l ~ dens, col = col.late, lwd = 2)
axis(1, at=c(0,10,20,30,40, 50), labels = c(0,10,20,30,40, 50))
mtext('distance(m)', side = 2, line=2)

legend('bottomright', lty = 1, legend = c("early", "mid", "late"), 
       col = c(col.early, col.mid, col.late))
```

## Storing models

I will store models as a tibble.

```{r}
# storing data and models
vitalRateModels <- tibble(phase = c("early", "mid", "late"),
                          data = list(data.early, data.mid, data.late),
                          survival = list(e.survival, m.survival, l.survival),
                          recruit = list(e.recruit, m.recruit, l.recruit),
                          adDispersal = list(e.dispersal.p, m.dispersal.p, l.dispersal.p),
                          adDistance = list(e.dispersal.dist, 
                                            m.dispersal.dist, l.dispersal.dist),
                          natDispersal = list(e.natal.p, m.natal.p, l.natal.p),
                          natDistance = list(e.natal.dist, m.natal.dist, l.natal.dist))

# saving models
saveRDS(vitalRateModels, file = file.path(here::here(), "results", "vitalRateModels.rds"))
```
